intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个共同信号：围绕编程 agent 的周边配套正在快速成型。有人做终端运行时，有人做多 agent 编排面板，有人做配置切换器，还有人直接给 agent 塞免费模型。模型能力本身不再是稀缺品，稀缺的是让 agent 稳定干活的那层壳，以及围绕它形成的真实使用场景。
intro.en: A clear pattern runs through today's picks: the scaffolding around coding agents is maturing faster than the agents themselves. Terminal runtimes, orchestration dashboards, config switchers, even plugins that hand agents free models.

zh.summary: 把多个 AI agent 当成一个团队来管的开源应用：给每个 agent 分配目标、选模型和 harness，在一个面板里看任务、成本、权限和历史。定位是 agent 的「公司管理层」，不是单个 agent 的壳。
zh.insight: 适合做多 agent 协作的成本与权限治理。切中小团队：谁在跑什么、花了多少、能碰哪些系统，这些现在基本靠人肉盯，做成一键合规报表就有价值。

en.summary: An open-source app that treats a fleet of AI agents like a team: assign goals per agent, pick models and harnesses, and track tasks, spend,
en.insight: The angle is cost and permission governance for multi-agent setups. Small teams cannot currently answer who ran what, what it cost, or what it touched;

items.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work

zh.summary: 一个 dsh 插件，装上后无需注册或 API Key 就能调用 DeepSeek、Kimi 等前沿模型，免费不限量，并附带 OpenAI 兼容的本地转发端口。它揭示了免费模型车道正在成为 agent 生态的入口。
zh.insight: 这更像趋势信号而非生意：免费通道依赖上游网关，随时可能变。真正可做的是给企业提供「免费车道 + 付费兜底」的模型路由与配额管理，把不确定性挡在外面。

en.summary: A dsh plugin that exposes frontier models like DeepSeek and Kimi with no signup or API key, free and uncapped, plus an OpenAI-compatible local proxy port.
en.insight: Read it as a signal, not a business: free lanes ride on upstream gateways that can vanish. The durable play is model routing and quota management for…

items.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: 给编程 agent 用的终端运行时：关掉客户端或断掉 SSH，后台服务里的会话继续跑，重启后还能恢复布局并续上支持的 agent 会话。多台机器的本地和远程工作也能收进一个窗口统一管理。
zh.insight: 切「agent 长时间跑任务」这个场景：现在的痛点是终端一断任务就死。可以围绕会话持久化和远程恢复做托管服务，或给团队做 agent 运行审计。

en.summary: A terminal runtime for coding agents that keeps sessions alive in a background server when you close the client or drop SSH, restores layouts after restarts,
en.insight: Target long-running agent tasks where a dropped terminal kills the work. A hosted layer for session persistence and remote resume,

items.description: the runtime your coding agents live on

zh.summary: 跨平台桌面工具，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等多个编程 agent 的 API 供应商、MCP、技能和提示词，省去手改 JSON/TOML/YAML 配置。解决的是多 agent 并存后配置碎片化的问题。
zh.insight: 配置管理本身难变现，但可以往团队方向走：集中下发供应商策略、密钥轮换、用量归集。切那些同时用三四个 agent 又要求合规的中型研发团队。

en.summary: A cross-platform desktop app that manages API providers, MCP servers, skills and prompts across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and others, replacing hand-edited JSON,
en.insight: Config tooling is hard to monetize alone, but the team version is real: centrally push provider policies, rotate keys, aggregate usage.

items.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io

zh.summary: 纯 Rust 写的开源参数化 3D CAD，桌面、浏览器、WASM 都能跑，内置 MCP 服务器让 AI agent 直接建模。把传统上笨重昂贵的 CAD 变成可脚本化、可被 agent 调用的工具。
zh.insight: 机会在「agent 建模」的垂直封装：面向 3D 打印爱好者或小批量硬件团队，把常用零件参数化，用户说需求、agent 改尺寸出 STEP，比通用 CAD 更省事。

en.summary: An open-source parametric 3D CAD written in pure Rust, running on desktop, in the browser via WASM, with a built-in MCP server so AI agents can model directly.
en.insight: The opening is vertical packaging around agent-driven modeling: for 3D-printing hobbyists or small hardware teams,

items.description: SolidCraft: an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Desktop, web, and automation through MCP.

zh.summary: 用 Rust 从零重写 Minecraft Java 版，靠三百多个差分测试对照原版校验世界生成和规则，不含任何原版代码或素材，需要用户自备正版。它证明了大型游戏逻辑可以被干净地重新实现。
zh.insight: 对创业者是技术信号：差分测试驱动的重写方法可迁移到其他闭源但有行为规范的系统。对社区是性能机会，围绕低配设备和服务器端优化做托管更有戏。

en.summary: A from-scratch Rust rewrite of Minecraft Java Edition, validated against the original with 300-plus differential harnesses, shipping no Mojang code or assets.
en.insight: For founders it is a method signal: differential-test-driven rewrites transfer to other closed systems with observable behavior.

items.description: Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 rewritten from scratch in Rust, checked against vanilla with 281 differential harnesses. Get it with the Horizon launcher.

zh.summary: 参照 tvOS 设计的开源 Android TV 桌面，无广告无推荐流，开机自动接管，适配小米、TCL、创维等国产电视。还支持手机扫码整理图标、航拍屏保和自定义壁纸。
zh.insight: 国产电视桌面广告是真实痛点，但纯开源难收钱。可做的是面向酒店、民宿、展厅的定制桌面：统一应用集、远程配置、品牌壁纸，按设备收部署费。

en.summary: An open-source Android TV launcher modeled on tvOS: no ads, no recommendation feed, auto-starts on boot, and works on Xiaomi, TCL, Skyworth and similar China-market TVs,
en.insight: TV launcher ads are a genuine pain, but pure open source will not pay. The product is a customized launcher for hotels, rentals and showrooms: fixed app sets,

items.description: 给国产电视的一块干净桌面：参照 tvOS 设计的开源 Android TV 桌面，没有广告，开机自动接管。A tvOS-style launcher for Xiaomi, TCL and other China-market TVs.

zh.summary: 把 AI 编程助手改造成视频制作室：用自然语言描述需求，agent 负责调研、写脚本、生成素材、剪辑和合成，内置多条制作管线和大量技能文件。本质是把视频生产流程拆成 agent 可执行的步骤。
zh.insight: 别再做通用视频工具，切垂直品类：电商短视频、课程片头、本地化配音。差异在于把行业模板和素材规范固化进管线，让非专业用户一次出片。

en.summary: Turns a coding assistant into a video studio: describe what you want, and the agent handles research, scripting, asset generation,
en.insight: Skip generic video tools and own a vertical: e-commerce clips, course intros, localized voiceover.

items.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

zh.summary: 完全离线的开源语音转文字桌面应用：按快捷键说话，文字直接落到任意输入框，全程不联网。它填补的是真正可扩展、免费、隐私优先的听写工具空缺。
zh.insight: 切隐私敏感行业：医疗、法律、律所记录，或涉密研发。差异不是识别率，而是可自托管、可审计、可换模型，卖的是部署和合规而不是软件本身。

en.summary: A fully offline, open-source speech-to-text desktop app: hit a shortcut, speak, and words land in any text field without touching the cloud.
en.insight: Aim at privacy-bound sectors: clinics, law firms, defense R&D. The differentiator is not accuracy but self-hosting, auditability and swappable models;

items.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.

zh.summary: 开源自托管的健身与自重训练记录应用，有 iPhone、Apple Watch 和 Android 版本，能规划训练、记录动作、看肌肉覆盖，并支持从 Strong、Hevy 等导入数据。一个 docker compose 就能跑，数据在自己手里。
zh.insight: 健身数据迁移是现成入口：很多人被订阅制锁住。可以做「数据搬家 + 自托管托管」服务，或面向私教的多人训练管理，按教练而非按用户收费。

en.summary: A self-hosted gym and bodyweight tracker with iPhone, Apple Watch and Android builds: plan routines, log sets, see muscle coverage, and import from Strong, Hevy or FitNotes.
en.insight: Data migration is the wedge: many users feel locked into subscriptions. Offer a move-your-data plus hosting service,

items.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
